name: year
description: Reference year of data collection, derived from the survey cycle and round
observations: PIAAC carries no year-of-collection variable. Cycle 1 Round 1 was collected Aug 2011-Mar 2012 (2012), Round 2 Apr 2014-Mar 2015 (2015), Round 3 Jul-Dec 2017 (2017); Cycle 2 Round 1 was collected Sep 2022-Aug 2023 (2023)

name: cycle
description: Survey cycle of the Survey of Adult Skills (1 or 2)

name: round
description: Round of data collection within the cycle
observations: Cycle 1 ran three rounds; Cycle 2 has run one so far

name: country_id_iso_3
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the participating country

name: country_id_m49
description: UN M49 numeric code of the participating country

name: country_entity_id
description: Code of the participating country or sub-national entity as reported by PIAAC
observations: Distinct from country_id_m49 where a country took part as a sub-national entity: Belgium participated as Flanders in both cycles and the United Kingdom as England in Cycle 2. Not a country code, so it carries no directory link

name: respondent_id
description: Randomly derived sequential identifier of the respondent
observations: Unique within a country and cycle only, never across them; combine with year and country_id_iso_3 for a unique key

name: item_code
description: Code of the assessment item, shared by every measure recorded for it
observations: The PIAAC variable name without its measure suffix, e.g. C301C05 for variables C301C05S, C301C05TT, C301C05A

name: domain
description: Assessment domain the item belongs to
observations: Literacy, numeracy, problem solving, reading or numeracy components, plus the tutorial and effort-question blocks, which share the same per-item measure structure

name: scored_response
description: Scored response code as recorded by PIAAC
observations: Codes are item-specific: 1 is Full Credit for most items but Partial Credit for some, and 11 has four distinct meanings across items. Read scored_response_label rather than interpreting the code directly

name: scored_response_label
description: Meaning of scored_response, decoded with the item's own scoring scheme

name: raw_response
description: Response as entered by the respondent, for items that record one
observations: Recorded for reading and numeracy component items. For numeric-entry items this is the answer itself, so it carries no decoded label

name: timing_seconds
description: Total time the respondent spent on the item

name: timing_first_action_seconds
description: Time elapsed before the respondent's first action on the item

name: n_actions
description: Number of actions the respondent took on the item

name: n_visits
description: Number of times the respondent visited the item

name: n_short_visits
description: Number of visits to the item shorter than the PIAAC minimum duration
